title: Kitfo
description: Kitfo is a Ethiopia classic prepared with yellow onion, niter kibbeh, mitmita, ground beef. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. This is a fully cooked kitfo-style adaptation. Traditional kitfo is often raw or lightly cooked and requires specialist raw-meat handling.

steps.instruction: Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 8 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Cook minced beef in the spiced butter over medium heat until fully browned with no raw center; this is a cooked kitfo-style serving.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
